2.3.m: Then Hari, having gone swiftly to the delightful foremost mountain,

2.3.s:
7 prabhāsapuṣkaragayānaimiṣakurukṣetrādipañcadhārātīrthamāhātmyam, pañcadhārātīrthānāṃ mali-
natvaprāptistannivṛttyarthaṃ ca teṣāṃ badarikāśrame gamanam, somakuṇḍasyotpattipūrvakaṃ
māhātmyam, saptapadacatuḥsrotorvaśītīrthamāhātmyam.... 130

7 प्रभासपुष्करगयानैमिषकुरुक्षेत्रादिपञ्चधारातीर्थमाहात्म्यम्, पञ्चधारातीर्थानां मलि-
नत्वप्राप्तिस्तन्निवृत्त्यर्थं च तेषां बदरिकाश्रमे गमनम्, सोमकुण्डस्योत्पत्तिपूर्वकं
माहात्म्यम्, सप्तपदचतुःस्रोतोर्वशीतीर्थमाहात्म्यम्.... 130
2.3.m: 7 The māhātmya of the Pañcadhārātīrtha consisting of Prabhāsa, Puṣkara, Gayā, Naimiṣa, Kurukṣetra, and others; the Pañcadhārātīrthas becoming defiled and their journey to Badarikāśrama for the removal of that [impurity]; the māhātmya preceded by the origin of Somakuṇḍa; the māhātmya of Saptapada, Catuḥsrotas, and Urvaśītīrtha... 130

2.3.s:
8 viśālāyāṃ bhagavadāvāsena saṃtuṣṭairiṃdrādibhirmeruṃ hitvā viśālāṃ prati gamanam, tadā
bhagavatendrādisukhahetormerostatra viśālāyāṃ sthāpanam, devairbhagavatstutikaraṇam, bhagavadājñayā devānāṃ tatraiva vāsaḥ, badarikāśrame lokapālasthāpanam, badarikāśrame dānena sarvaphalaprāptivarṇanam, dharmakṣetravarṇanam, daṇḍapuṣkariṇītīrthavarṇanam.... 132 2

8 विशालायां भगवदावासेन संतुष्टैरिंद्रादिभिर्मेरुं हित्वा विशालां प्रति गमनम्, तदा
भगवतेन्द्रादिसुखहेतोर्मेरोस्तत्र विशालायां स्थापनम्, देवैर्भगवत्स्तुतिकरणम्, भगवदाज्ञया देवानां तत्रैव वासः, बदरिकाश्रमे लोकपालस्थापनम्, बदरिकाश्रमे दानेन सर्वफलप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, धर्मक्षेत्रवर्णनम्, दण्डपुष्करिणीतीर्थवर्णनम्.... 132 2
2.3.m: 8 Indra and the others, delighted by the Lord's dwelling in Viśālā, abandon Meru and go towards Viśālā; then the Lord's installation of Meru there in Viśālā for the happiness of Indra and the others; praise of the Lord by the gods; by the Lord's command, the gods' dwelling right there; installation of the World Protectors in Badarikāśrama; description of the attainment of all fruits through giving in Badarikāśrama; description of Dharmakṣetra; description of Daṇḍapuṣkariṇītīrtha... 132 2
